utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll keep an eye on the board tomorrow morning and let you both know if anything's posted.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Uli, that would be so helpful—thank you! I really don't want to miss it this time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No trouble at all, Oren. I'm heading past there first thing anyway.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Ira, I've got my toolbox ready for the repair drive this Saturday—should be a big help at the corner lot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Gus, that's great! I've got my truck lined up too, ready to haul whatever we need for the corner lot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, Ira—between your truck and my tools, we'll make quick work of fixing up those donated items.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Vik, I heard you might be joining the repair drive on Saturday—do you know if it's still 10 to 4 at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, it's definitely happening, Hana! Saturday, 9 AM at the community center—not 10. I'm even helping Mrs. Chen haul her old furniture over to the repair tent.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, Vik—I thought it was 10 to 4. Are you sure about 9? I don't want to show up at the wrong time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, hey Sam! The repair drive—yeah, I keep meaning to get those flyers out. Jules offered to help, but I haven't printed them yet. Did you need something for it?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help print those flyers if you want—just say the word.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that'd be amazing, Sam! I keep getting sidetracked, so if you could take over the printing, that'd be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Repair drive? Are you sure that's actually happening? I haven't heard a thing about it from anyone official.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard it from a neighbor, but I can't remember who. Maybe it's not set in stone yet.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you're not even sure who told you? That makes me wonder if it's even on the calendar.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Eli, have you heard anything about the repair drive timing? I'm trying to fit it around school drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Faye—we're set for Saturday at 9 in the morning. That should fit nicely before school.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, that's perfect timing! I'll drop the kids at school and head straight over.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Cleo, are you going to the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, I'll be there early to help sort donations—got a bunch of folks bringing tools and such.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's great, Cleo. I'll see you there then—I can help with anything you need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Bo, have you seen if that repair truck finally moved from Johnson's to the corner lot? I want to make sure we have everything ready for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, I haven't had a chance to look, sorry—got to run! But I'll bring that old drill Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Alright, but if you see it moved, let me know. Last thing we need is chaos before the drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Quinn, I'm planning to be there around 2 PM tomorrow for the repairs, though I might be a bit late. I'll bring my toolbox and any extra screws I can find.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Dane! That sounds perfect—we'll have plenty of tools with yours. See you then!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Awesome, I'll see you then! I'll grab whatever brackets I can find too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Leo, are you sure you can make it to the repair drive on Saturday? I don't want us to be short-handed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, I'll be there. Tools are ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, just double-checking. Do you know if we have enough spare parts for the number of people signed up?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Mina, are you thinking of joining the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, I'm organizing it. Saturday from 10am to 4pm. Do you have something to bring in for repair?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, I didn't realize you were organizing! I was actually planning to bring in my old toaster—it's been acting up lately.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rosa, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? They're collecting tools and appliances to fix up for folks in need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Actually, Tess! It's been moved to Sunday at the community center. We could use a hand spreading the word—can you help?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, sure thing, Rosa! I'll tell everyone I see about the new time and place.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Uli, I'm heading over to check if that repair truck finally moved from Johnson's to the corner lot. Can't have it blocking things.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I already checked the board, but I haven't seen any update on the drive schedule. Let me know if you spot anything new at the corner.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do, Uli. I'll be back in a jiffy with a clear report on whether that truck's shifted or not.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Oren, I heard the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center—they're fixing up old bikes and appliances and need volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that's right! The repair drive. Saturday, community center—great, I think I've got it now. Thanks, Nell, you're a lifesaver.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: No problem, Oren! I just hope we don't all show up at different times or places—this thing's been a bit of a puzzle to figure out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey, did you hear the repair truck finally moved to the corner lot? We can get that drive cleared up this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh great, so the drive's still on for Saturday at 10 at the community center then? I've got an old drill I can finally drop off.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, Saturday morning at 10—community center's the spot. I'll be there with my toolbox and a few spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey, Jules! Right, the flyers—I completely forgot about printing them. Sorry, where did we say we wanted to distribute them again?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We were planning on the coffee shop, but Rosa just told me the drive's been moved to Sunday at the community center, so maybe we should update the flyers and hand them out there instead.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sunday at the community center? Right, that rings a bell now—thanks for keeping me straight on that.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, we're set for Saturday at 9. I'll be in my shed sorting things out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's wonderful, Eli! I heard Cleo's got the garage all set up, so it'll be a proper community effort.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'm glad to hear that. Cleo's a reliable one—I'll make sure my lamp's ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, my mistake! Well, I'm helping Vik with hauling anyway.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, Vik? I thought he was just promoting it—are you saying he's actually running the thing now?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Well, he's the one gathering stuff from Mrs. Chen's, so I guess he's in charge of the messy parts!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Leo, did you catch that repair drive flyer? I think it's happening tomorrow at 2 PM.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's Saturday, not tomorrow. Check the flyer again.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh right, Saturday. I must've mixed up the days. Thanks for clearing that up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Sam! Yeah, the repair drive is this weekend at the old garage. We're collecting tools and appliances to fix up for folks in need.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Cleo! What do you need me to bring or help with?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam! I could really use help sorting donations and maybe some elbow grease on repairs. Bring any spare tools or working appliances you have.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, so the repair drive is 9 to 3 and the block party's later—that's a relief. I just want to make sure we don't have folks rushing between events.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Actually, it's Saturday from 10am to 4pm, not 9 to 3. Are you planning to bring something to fix, or just help out?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, 10 to 4—got it, thanks for the correction. I'll probably just help out, I don't have anything major to fix.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Faye, do you know when the repair drive is coming through our street?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I've heard different times from different people—some say 9 to 3, others 10 to 4. I'm trying to figure it out myself with the kids' schedules.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I'm a bit mixed up too. I thought it was this Saturday afternoon, but now I'm not sure.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, Mara! I'm definitely in—and I've just updated the location to the community center on Sunday. Hope that still works with your schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That works perfectly, Rosa! Sunday at the community center sounds great—I'll bring my toolbox and see you there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Mara! I'll update the flyers and let the others know. Thanks for being so flexible.
